ci_history.observed: Static guard and Docker Compose schema validation passed; exact image pulls and Compose startup passed; health polling had not returned and the GitHub Actions run metadata had not advanced.
ci_history.response: Added connect and total-request timeouts plus a finite 30-attempt health loop so failure is bounded and diagnostic.

ci_history.observed: The authenticated health check failed because Kestra terminated with AccessDeniedException at /app/storage/plugins. GitHub Actions also did not upload the evidence bundle because its directory name started with a dot and hidden files were excluded.
ci_history.response: Added an isolated one-shot volume permission bootstrap restricted to CHOWN, no network and no Docker socket; kept the long-running service non-root. Renamed the CI evidence directory to a non-hidden path.

ci_history.observed: Static validation and Compose schema passed, image downloads completed, then container startup failed. The CI log showed Compose interpolation warnings that kestra_uid/kestra_gid were unset because Compose consumed shell dollar variables inside the command.
ci_history.response: Escaped shell variables as $$ in the Compose file and extended the static guard to enforce this invariant before startup.

ci_history.observed: The new guard correctly required escaped $$ expressions, but a redundant negative check incorrectly matched the second dollar in a valid $$(...) form. Runtime test did not run.
ci_history.response: Removed the invalid substring-based negative assertion; the positive checks for each required escaped shell variable remain.

ci_history.observed: Static validation passed but Compose still saw single-dollar shell variables, emitted kestra_uid/kestra_gid unset warnings, and storage-init exited with code 2. The attempted patch had been transformed by JavaScript replacement-string semantics before commit.
ci_history.response: Updated the commit-generation procedure to use callback replacements that preserve literal $$ characters, and changed the static validator to require the exact double-dollar forms.
